title: Opportunity-tailored Markdown and PDF resume synchronization

rules: Every opportunity directory contains one guide bound to the exact current Markdown and PDF digests.
A ready guide gives exact actions for observed fields and names no unresolved blocker.
A blocked guide names the blocking condition and does not invent fields or answers.
Protected-category answers remain Jamie's private choice and are never committed.
Unknown later application pages fail closed for Jamie's review.

criteria.criterion: Every governed hiring-reader opportunity has exactly one dated Markdown resume, one PDF sibling, one artifact manifest, and one application guide; no tailored Markdown resume is orphaned from the opportunity manifest.
Each artifact is bound to the current SHA-256 of its governed opportunity source so a changed role brief forces re-tailoring and review.
The exact Markdown digest matches both the hiring-reader assessment manifest and the PDF artifact manifest.
Each PDF records a native Google Docs copy workflow, preserved source styles, connector readback, and an unchanged read-only style source without committing protected document locators.
Each PDF is digest-bound, tagged, one or two US Letter pages, and machine-readable.
Each PDF embeds the established Palatino Linotype, Oswald, and Karla typography.
Every exported page has a complete visual-inspection receipt covering clipping, overlap, glyphs, Markdown residue, grouping, hierarchy, links, spacing, and page balance.

Hiring-facing resumes omit nonessential non-disbursement disposition language; whenever Politico New York appears, its full visible label links to the canonical archived article PDF in both Markdown and the exported PDF.

Each opportunity directory includes an exact-resume-bound application guide with the observed field actions, an explicit blocker when needed, fail-closed treatment of unseen questions, and Jamie's final-submit gate.
Neither resume, artifact metadata, nor application guide commits Google Docs IDs, Drive locators, private filesystem paths, protected-category answers, or other protected workflow identifiers.
